questions.prompt: How many Rings of Power were given to Men?
questions.explanation: The bearers of these Rings were corrupted and became Sauron's most feared servants.

questions.prompt: The War of the Ring takes place at the end of which Age?
questions.explanation: The Third Age ends with the destruction of the Ring and the departure of many Elves.

questions.prompt: In which Age was the One Ring forged?
questions.explanation: Sauron forged the One Ring in the Second Age, in the days when the Elven-smiths made the other Rings of Power.

questions.prompt: Who cut the One Ring from Sauron's hand?
questions.explanation: Isildur took the Ring after his father Elendil fell, and kept it instead of destroying it.

questions.prompt: What was the name of the sword of Elendil that broke in his last battle?
questions.explanation: Narsil was broken when Elendil fell, and was reforged as Andúril for Aragorn.

questions.prompt: What name does Aragorn take as King of Gondor?
questions.explanation: Elessar means 'Elfstone'; Aragorn was also called Estel and Strider.

questions.prompt: What was the great alliance of Elves and Men that marched against Sauron and besieged Barad-dûr called?
questions.explanation: The Last Alliance of Elves and Men besieged Barad-dûr and overthrew Sauron.

questions.prompt: Which island kingdom of Men was swallowed by the sea?
questions.explanation: Númenor was drowned after its king defied the Valar.

questions.prompt: Who crafted the Silmarils?
questions.explanation: Fëanor captured the light of the Two Trees in the three Silmarils.

questions.prompt: Which Dark Lord of the First Age was the master of Sauron?
questions.explanation: Morgoth, also called Melkor, was the first Dark Lord, and Sauron was his chief servant.

questions.prompt: How many Silmarils did Fëanor make?
questions.explanation: The three Silmarils were stolen by Morgoth and caused long wars.

questions.prompt: Which conflict ended the First Age by overthrowing Morgoth?
questions.explanation: The Host of the Valar fought Morgoth and broke Beleriand in the War of Wrath.

questions.prompt: Which two brothers ruled Gondor together in the south, while their father held the High Kingship in the north?
questions.explanation: Isildur and Anárion founded Gondor together and ruled it jointly while their father held the High Kingship in the north.

questions.prompt: Which northern realm was ruled by the Witch-king?
questions.explanation: Angmar attacked and ruined the kingdoms of the north.

questions.prompt: Who was High King of both Arnor and Gondor after escaping the fall of Númenor?
questions.explanation: Elendil ruled Arnor in the north, while his sons ruled Gondor.

questions.prompt: What title did the rulers of Gondor hold after the line of kings ended?
questions.explanation: The Stewards ruled in the king's name until Aragorn returned.

questions.prompt: Who found the Ring while fishing and was killed by Sméagol for it?
questions.explanation: Déagol was Sméagol's friend, and Sméagol strangled him to get the Ring.

questions.prompt: Which brothers led the Hobbits into the Shire?
questions.explanation: Marcho and Blanco received the land from the King at Fornost.

questions.prompt: Who was the first King of Númenor?
questions.explanation: Elros, a Half-elf, chose to be mortal and took the name Tar-Minyatur.

questions.prompt: In which Age were the realms of Gondor and Arnor founded?
questions.explanation: Exiles from the drowned Númenor founded both realms, Gondor in the south and Arnor in the north.

questions.prompt: Near which place was Isildur killed in an Orc ambush?
questions.explanation: The Ring slipped from his finger and was lost in the Anduin.

questions.prompt: Who was the first Ruling Steward of Gondor?
questions.explanation: Mardil Voronwë, the Steadfast, ruled after the last king Eärnur disappeared.

questions.prompt: On which plain did the Last Alliance defeat the armies of Sauron before besieging Barad-dûr?
questions.explanation: Dagorlad, the Battle Plain, lies before the Black Gate of Mordor.

questions.prompt: Who was the last King of Arnor?
questions.explanation: After Arvedui's death, the Dúnedain of the North were ruled by Chieftains.

questions.prompt: Which council of Wizards and Elves, formed in the Third Age, drove Sauron out of his stronghold in Mirkwood?
questions.explanation: Saruman was chosen as head of the White Council, which also included Gandalf and Elrond.

questions.prompt: Which King under the Mountain ruled Erebor when Smaug attacked?
questions.explanation: Thrór, Thorin's grandfather, fled Erebor when Smaug arrived.

questions.prompt: Which mariner sailed to Valinor to plead for the Valar's help against Morgoth?
questions.explanation: Eärendil's plea led to the War of Wrath.

questions.prompt: Who killed the dragon Glaurung?
questions.explanation: Túrin slew Glaurung at Cabed-en-Aras, but died soon after.

questions.prompt: Which First Age battle is also called the Battle of Unnumbered Tears?
questions.explanation: In this battle the Elves and Men were defeated by Morgoth.

questions.prompt: Which land was home to the Elven-smiths who made the Rings of Power with Sauron's help?
questions.explanation: Eregion, also called Hollin, was the Elven realm where the Rings of Power were made.

questions.prompt: Which Age begins after the destruction of the One Ring and the passing of the Elves?
questions.explanation: The Fourth Age is the Age of Men, which begins as the power of the Elves fades.

questions.prompt: By what title did Sauron live in hiding in a fortress in the south of the great forest?
questions.explanation: In later years Sauron lived in disguise as the Necromancer, until the White Council drove him out.

questions.prompt: In which language is the inscription on the One Ring written?
questions.explanation: The inscription is in the Black Speech, a language devised by Sauron.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Bilbo's small Elven blade, which glows blue when Orcs are near?
questions.explanation: Sting was found in a Troll hoard, and passes from Bilbo to Frodo.

questions.prompt: Bilbo and Frodo share which birthday?
questions.explanation: Both hobbits were born on 22 September, the date on which the party is held in The Fellowship of the Ring.

questions.prompt: What precious metal, light and stronger than steel, was the mail shirt that Bilbo gave Frodo made of?
questions.explanation: The mithril-coat saves Frodo's life when he is struck by a spear.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the Elven waybread that sustains travellers on long journeys?
questions.explanation: A single cake of lembas can sustain a traveller through a long day's labour.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the sword carried by Gandalf, whose name means 'Foe-hammer'?
questions.explanation: Glamdring was found with another blade in a Troll hoard, and is an old sword of Gondolin.

questions.prompt: What emblem does the banner of Gondor bear on a black field?
questions.explanation: The royal banner of Gondor shows the White Tree beneath a crown and seven stars; Arwen made one for Aragorn.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the book in which Bilbo and Frodo recorded their adventures?
questions.explanation: The Red Book of Westmarch contained Bilbo's and Frodo's memoirs, and was added to by Sam and others.

questions.prompt: Which of the Elven Rings is known as the Ring of Adamant?
questions.explanation: Nenya, the Ring of Water, was made of mithril and set with a white stone of adamant.

questions.prompt: Which of the Elven Rings, set with a great blue stone, passed from Gil-galad to the Lord of Rivendell?
questions.explanation: Vilya, the Ring of Air, was the mightiest of the Elven Rings.

questions.prompt: By what Elvish name, meaning 'Grey Pilgrim', was Gandalf known?
questions.explanation: Mithrandir is the Sindarin name that the Elves gave to Gandalf.

questions.prompt: What act of the Númenóreans led to the destruction of their island?
questions.answer: A fleet sent against the Undying Lands
questions.explanation: Ar-Pharazôn's armada landed in Aman, and the Valar called on Ilúvatar, who drowned the island.

questions.prompt: Who became King of Arnor as the youngest son of the High King who took the Ring from Sauron?
questions.explanation: Valandil, the youngest son, was at Rivendell when his father and brothers were killed by Orcs, and later ruled Arnor.

questions.prompt: Who was the last King of Gondor, who rode to the gates of a haunted city, answering a challenge, and never returned?
questions.explanation: Eärnur rode to answer the challenge of the Witch-king and was never seen again.

questions.prompt: Who, in despair after the Dagor Bragollach, rode to challenge Morgoth to single combat?
questions.explanation: Fingolfin wounded Morgoth seven times before he was killed.

questions.prompt: Which Orc chieftain slew the Dwarf-king Thrór in Moria, beginning the War of the Dwarves and Orcs?
questions.explanation: Azog beheaded Thrór at the gate of Moria, and the Dwarves swore revenge.

questions.prompt: What disaster, in the year 1636 of the Third Age, killed many people in Gondor and Eriador?
questions.explanation: The Great Plague weakened Gondor and the northern realm.

questions.prompt: Who is the son and heir of Aragorn and Arwen?
questions.explanation: Eldarion is named in the Appendices as the son of the king and queen.

questions.prompt: What name is given to the civil war in Gondor in the fifteenth century of the Third Age?
questions.explanation: The Kin-strife was a civil war between King Eldacar and his kinsman Castamir, and it weakened Gondor.

questions.prompt: Which battle of the First Age, the 'Battle of Sudden Flame', broke the Siege of Angband?
questions.explanation: In the Dagor Bragollach, Morgoth's fire poured forth and broke the siege.

questions.prompt: In which battle of 2799 of the Third Age did the Dwarves defeat the Orcs before the East-gate of Moria?
questions.explanation: At Azanulbizar, also called the Battle of Nanduhirion, the Dwarves won, but at great cost.

questions.prompt: Which hobbit of the Southfarthing was the first to grow pipe-weed in the Shire?
questions.explanation: Tobold Hornblower of Longbottom first grew the pipe-weed around 1070 of the Shire Reckoning.

questions.prompt: Who was the first Thain of the Shire?
questions.explanation: Bucca of the Marish held the office when the Shire's Thainship began.

questions.prompt: Which Captain of the Southern Army of Gondor won the Battle of the Camp against the Wainriders and was then chosen as king?
questions.explanation: After the king and his heirs fell, Eärnil destroyed the Wainriders' camp in 1944 and was crowned the next year.

questions.prompt: Which king of Durin's folk was killed by the Balrog awakened beneath Moria?
questions.explanation: Durin VI was slain by the Balrog in 1980 of the Third Age; the Balrog was afterwards known as Durin's Bane.

questions.prompt: Which Vala pronounced the Doom upon the Noldor who left Valinor?
questions.explanation: Mandos, the Doomsman of the Valar, pronounced the Doom of the Noldor.

questions.prompt: Which Vala made the Dwarves, seeking to create them before the Elves awoke?
questions.explanation: Aulë made the Dwarves, and Ilúvatar adopted them as his children.

questions.prompt: By what name, 'Lord of Gifts', did Sauron present himself to the Elven-smiths?
questions.explanation: Sauron disguised himself as Annatar to persuade the Elves to make the Rings of Power.
